describes: packages/plugin/search with a Stage: viewport-first scans and reveal-on-navigate.

cases.name: viewport-first-start-page
cases.covers: With a Stage the scan starts at the current page's pon; exec.startPage overrides it; rerun() starts viewport-first again from wherever the Stage now is.

cases.name: no-pages-no-start-page
cases.covers: A Stage over a document with no pages has no current page to name, so the scan starts with no startPage.

cases.name: navigation-reveals-the-hit
cases.covers: next/prev/goTo reveal the hit's page at its bounds with the find-bar default arrival (anchor y 0.35, smooth); a hit with no segments reveals with no rect.

cases.name: reveal-options-merge
cases.covers: Arrival options merge per key: per-call over plugin config over the default. An explicit undefined anchor overrides the default away (a bare reveal when the hit has no rect); a null config anchor is a positioned reveal with no anchor axes.

cases.name: reveal-config-anchor-null
cases.covers: A config anchor of null replaces the default: the reveal is positioned (anchor present) with neither axis set.
